versions.changelog:
Initial release of Feishu CRM Automation skill:

- Enables automated customer info entry into Feishu Bitable.
- Provides overdue follow-up reminders for customers not contacted in configurable days (default: 3).
- Generates weekly customer summary reports, including new customers and status breakdown.
- Supports Feishu Bitable integration with default field mappings and formats.
- Responds to common CRM scenarios, such as new entry, follow-up check, and weekly reporting.
